title: tabernaemontana vitiensis
intro: Tabernaemontana vitiensis, commonly known as the Fiji rose apple or rose apple tree, is a plant species belonging to the Apocynaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Tabernaemontana vitiensis include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its use in treating wounds and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
